My pick: ESR CryoBoost 3-in-1 Magnetic Charging Station (Qi2.2, 25W). Based on the search results you provided, it’s the strongest match if you want one stand to charge your iPhone, Apple Watch, and AirPods, with faster charging for compatible iPhones.

Best overall for speed
1. ESR CryoBoost 3-in-1 Magnetic Charging Station Qi2.2 25W
$82.00 with code PARTNER18

Regular price: $99.99

Up to 25W Qi2.2 iPhone charging for compatible models.

Dedicated Apple Watch charger and AirPods charging pad.

Active cooling fan and included 50W power adapter.

The supplied results report the discount was tested October 23, 2026, and the code expires December 31, 2026.

Buy at ESR via the supplied deal link

2. Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand
$80–$98

Best for a polished bedside setup

Up to 15W iPhone charging.

Adjustable phone angle, with portrait and landscape positioning.

Supports Apple Watch charging and has an AirPods charging area in the base.

A good option if you don't need 25W charging.
Shop at Best Buy

Source: WIRED's tested 3-in-1 chargers

3. Satechi 3-in-1 Foldable Wireless Charging Stand Qi2 25W
$129.99

Best for an adjustable desk stand that travels

Up to 25W Qi2 charging for compatible iPhones.

Adjustable phone stand and fast charging for compatible Apple Watches.

Folds for travel and includes a 45W power adapter.

Costs more and is smaller when folded than a fixed desktop setup.
Shop at Satechi

Source: Macworld's hands-on review

Before buying: Verify the charging speed supported by your exact iPhone model. The advertised 25W maximum is not available on every iPhone, and AirPods must have a compatible wireless-charging case.

One question that could change my recommendation: Which iPhone do you have? The iPhone model determines whether paying extra for a 25W stand is worthwhile.
